entries.title: Isaiah 16:1
segments: Send the lamb to the ruler of the land from the rock of the desert to the mount of the daughter of Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:2
segments: For it shall be as a fleeing bird cast out of the nest, the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:3
segments: Take counsel, do judgment; make your shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; do not betray the fugitive.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:4
segments: Let my outcasts dwell with you, Moab; be a shelter to them from the face of the destroyer; for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceases, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:5
segments: And in mercy the throne shall be established; and [he] shall sit on it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging and seeking judgment, and speeding righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:6
segments: We have heard of the pride of Moab; very proud; even of his vanity, and his pride, and his rage; not so [are] his babblings.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:7
segments: So Moab shall howl for Moab, everyone shall howl. All of it shall howl for the foundations of Kir-hareseth; surely [they are] stricken.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:8
segments: For Heshbon's fields droop, the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have crushed its choice plants, they have come to Jazer, they wander [in] the desert; her branches are stretched out, they have crossed the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:9
segments: On account of this I will weep with the weeping of Jazer, the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, O Heshbon and Elealeh; for the shouting has fallen on your fruit and on your harvest.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:10
segments: And gladness and joy are gathered out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there is no singing and no shouting. The treader shall tread out no wine in the presses; I have made their shouting to cease.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:11
segments: Therefore my belly shall sound like a harp for Moab, and my bowels for Kir-hareseth.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:12
segments: And it shall be when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, he shall come to his sacred place to pray; but he shall not be able.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:13
segments: This [is] the word that the LORD has spoken to Moab since that time.

entries.title: Isaiah 16:14
segments: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of a hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be abased with all that great host and the remnant few; small, not mighty.
